question: Is the USL active? Every line from four silos, resolved to a medicine, in one table.
sql: SELECT source_system, resolved_by, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(generic) AS resolved, COUNT(high_risk_class) AS high_risk_lines FROM lightning.metastore.medtrace.medtrace_usl.medication_statement GROUP BY source_system, resolved_by ORDER BY source_system
